en: Joel 1

p.src: 1  The LORD’s word that came to Joel, the son of Pethuel.

en: The LORD’s word that came to Joel, the son of Pethuel.
u.src: 1  The LORD’s word that came to Joel, the son of Pethuel.

ja: 1:1 すべて大文字の「主」または「神」は、神の固有名であるヘブル語「יהוה」（通常「ヤハウェ」と発音される）の訳である。
en: 1:1 When rendered in ALL CAPITAL LETTERS, “LORD” or “GOD” is the translation of God’s Proper Name (Hebrew “יהוה”, usually pronounced Yahweh).

zh: 百姓因收成受損壞而悲傷

p.src: 2  Hear this, you elders, and listen, all you inhabitants of the land! Has this ever happened in your days, or in the days of your fathers?

ja: けよ。 このようなことが、あなたがたの時代に起こったことがあるか。 また、あなたがたの父
en: Hear this, you elders, and listen, all you inhabitants of the land! Has this ever happened in your days, or in the days of your fathers?
u.src: 2  Hear this, you elders, and listen, all you inhabitants of the land! Has this ever happened in your days, or in the days of your fathers?

p.src: 3  Tell your children about it, and have your children tell their children, and their children, another generation.

ja: このことをあなたがたの
en: Tell your children about it, and have your children tell their children, and their children, another generation.
u.src: 3  Tell your children about it, and have your children tell their children, and their children, another generation.

p.src: 4  What the swarming locust has left, the great locust has eaten. What the great locust has left, the grasshopper has eaten. What the grasshopper has left, the caterpillar has eaten.

ja: したものを、大いなごが
べ、 大いなごが食べ
en: What the swarming locust has left, the great locust has eaten. What the great locust has left, the grasshopper has eaten. What the grasshopper has left, the caterpillar has eaten.
u.src: 4  What the swarming locust has left, the great locust has eaten. What the great locust has left, the grasshopper has eaten. What the grasshopper has left, the caterpillar has eaten.

p.src: 5  Wake up, you drunkards, and weep! Wail, all you drinkers of wine, because of the sweet wine, for it is cut off from your mouth.

ja: べ。 それはもう、あなたがたの
en: Wake up, you drunkards, and weep! Wail, all you drinkers of wine, because of the sweet wine, for it is cut off from your mouth.
u.src: 5  Wake up, you drunkards, and weep! Wail, all you drinkers of wine, because of the sweet wine, for it is cut off from your mouth.

p.src: 6  For a nation has come up on my land, strong, and without number. His teeth are the teeth of a lion, and he has the fangs of a lioness.

ja: えきれないほどの民だ。 その
en: For a nation has come up on my land, strong, and without number. His teeth are the teeth of a lion, and he has the fangs of a lioness.
u.src: 6  For a nation has come up on my land, strong, and without number. His teeth are the teeth of a lion, and he has the fangs of a lioness.

p.src: 7  He has laid my vine waste, and stripped my fig tree. He has stripped its bark, and thrown it away. Its branches are made white.

ja: らし、 私のいちじくの
った。 その皮をすっかりはぎ取って
en: He has laid my vine waste, and stripped my fig tree. He has stripped its bark, and thrown it away. Its branches are made white.
u.src: 7  He has laid my vine waste, and stripped my fig tree. He has stripped its bark, and thrown it away. Its branches are made white.

p.src: 8  Mourn like a virgin dressed in sackcloth for the husband of her youth!

ja: をまとったおとめのように
en: Mourn like a virgin dressed in sackcloth for the husband of her youth!
u.src: 8  Mourn like a virgin dressed in sackcloth for the husband of her youth!

p.src: 9  The meal offering and the drink offering are cut off from the LORD’s house. The priests, the LORD’s ministers, mourn.

en: The meal offering and the drink offering are cut off from the LORD’s house. The priests, the LORD’s ministers, mourn.
u.src: 9  The meal offering and the drink offering are cut off from the LORD’s house. The priests, the LORD’s ministers, mourn.

p.src: 10  The field is laid waste. The land mourns, for the grain is destroyed, The new wine has dried up, and the oil languishes.

ja: も尽きようとしている。
en: The field is laid waste. The land mourns, for the grain is destroyed, The new wine has dried up, and the oil languishes.
u.src: 10  The field is laid waste. The land mourns, for the grain is destroyed, The new wine has dried up, and the oil languishes.

p.src: 11  Be confounded, you farmers! Wail, you vineyard keepers, for the wheat and for the barley; for the harvest of the field has perished.

ja: たちよ、うろたえよ。 ぶどう畑を耕す者たちよ、泣き叫べ。
en: Be confounded, you farmers! Wail, you vineyard keepers, for the wheat and for the barley; for the harvest of the field has perished.
u.src: 11  Be confounded, you farmers! Wail, you vineyard keepers, for the wheat and for the barley; for the harvest of the field has perished.

p.src: 12  The vine has dried up, and the fig tree withered— the pomegranate tree, the palm tree also, and the apple tree, even all of the trees of the field are withered; for joy has withered away from the sons of men.

ja: もしおれた。 ざくろの
も、なつめやしも、りんごの
en: The vine has dried up, and the fig tree withered— the pomegranate tree, the palm tree also, and the apple tree, even all of the trees of the field are withered; for joy has withered away from the sons of men.
u.src: 12  The vine has dried up, and the fig tree withered— the pomegranate tree, the palm tree also, and the apple tree, even all of the trees of the field are withered; for joy has withered away from the sons of men.

p.src: 13  Put on sackcloth and mourn, you priests! Wail, you ministers of the altar. Come, lie all night in sackcloth, you ministers of my God, for the meal offering and the drink offering are withheld from your God’s house.

ja: の家から取り去られたからだ。
en: Put on sackcloth and mourn, you priests! Wail, you ministers of the altar. Come, lie all night in sackcloth, you ministers of my God, for the meal offering and the drink offering are withheld from your God’s house.
u.src: 13  Put on sackcloth and mourn, you priests! Wail, you ministers of the altar. Come, lie all night in sackcloth, you ministers of my God, for the meal offering and the drink offering are withheld from your God’s house.

ja: 1:13 「神」と訳されたヘブル語は「אֱלֹהִים」（エロヒム）である。
en: 1:13 The Hebrew word rendered “God” is “אֱלֹהִ֑ים” (Elohim).

p.src: 14  Sanctify a fast. Call a solemn assembly. Gather the elders and all the inhabitants of the land to the house of the LORD, your God, and cry to the LORD.

ja: に住むすべての者を、あなたがたの
en: Sanctify a fast. Call a solemn assembly. Gather the elders and all the inhabitants of the land to the house of the LORD, your God, and cry to the LORD.
u.src: 14  Sanctify a fast. Call a solemn assembly. Gather the elders and all the inhabitants of the land to the house of the LORD, your God, and cry to the LORD.

p.src: 15  Alas for the day! For the day of the LORD is at hand, and it will come as destruction from the Almighty.

en: Alas for the day! For the day of the LORD is at hand, and it will come as destruction from the Almighty.
u.src: 15  Alas for the day! For the day of the LORD is at hand, and it will come as destruction from the Almighty.

p.src: 16  Isn’t the food cut off before our eyes, joy and gladness from the house of our God?

ja: で食物が断たれ、 私たちの神の家から喜びと楽しみが失われたではないか。
en: Isn’t the food cut off before our eyes, joy and gladness from the house of our God?
u.src: 16  Isn’t the food cut off before our eyes, joy and gladness from the house of our God?

p.src: 17  The seeds rot under their clods. The granaries are laid desolate. The barns are broken down, for the grain has withered.

en: The seeds rot under their clods. The granaries are laid desolate. The barns are broken down, for the grain has withered.
u.src: 17  The seeds rot under their clods. The granaries are laid desolate. The barns are broken down, for the grain has withered.

p.src: 18  How the animals groan! The herds of livestock are perplexed, because they have no pasture. Yes, the flocks of sheep are made desolate.

ja: はうめいていることか。
en: How the animals groan! The herds of livestock are perplexed, because they have no pasture. Yes, the flocks of sheep are made desolate.
u.src: 18  How the animals groan! The herds of livestock are perplexed, because they have no pasture. Yes, the flocks of sheep are made desolate.

p.src: 19  LORD, I cry to you, for the fire has devoured the pastures of the wilderness, and the flame has burned all the trees of the field.

en: LORD, I cry to you, for the fire has devoured the pastures of the wilderness, and the flame has burned all the trees of the field.
u.src: 19  LORD, I cry to you, for the fire has devoured the pastures of the wilderness, and the flame has burned all the trees of the field.

p.src: 20  Yes, the animals of the field pant to you, for the water brooks have dried up, and the fire has devoured the pastures of the wilderness.

ja: さえ、あなたを慕ってあえぐ。
en: Yes, the animals of the field pant to you, for the water brooks have dried up, and the fire has devoured the pastures of the wilderness.
u.src: 20  Yes, the animals of the field pant to you, for the water brooks have dried up, and the fire has devoured the pastures of the wilderness.
